claims.claim_text: For listed equity holdings reported for 2024, the entity applies a PCAF-based approach using market value and issuer EVIC; where counterparty-level emissions are not used in investment records, the calculation uses a proxy basis.

claims.claim_text: Listed equity proxy methodology is market value (EUR million) divided by issuer EVIC (EUR million) multiplied by issuer revenue (EUR million), referencing PCAF Standard §B61 proxy; issuer revenue is used as a proxy input and the estimate is not presented as verified emissions.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Methodology (listed equity)
